_doc: Ground-truth YCB inertial variants for Isaac-Repose-Objects-LEAP-Direct-v1. Generated by scripts/generate_ycb_inertial_manifest.py from the sibling Estimate_weight_distribution density dataset (tet-mesh point-mass ground truth). Units: kg / m / kg*m^2. Frames: YCB canonical mesh frame == the wrapper-USD body-local frame. Inertia is about the COM; inertia = principal_axes @ diag(principal_moments) @ principal_axes.T; principal_axes_quat_wxyz is the quaternion of principal_axes.
